instruction.text: Match the main clauses to make compound sentences.

atoms.sound: Jenny likes running, and James enjoys cycling.

atoms.a: Becky would like to go to the party, ...
atoms.b: but she is too unwell to drive.
atoms.sound: Becky would like to go to the party, but she is too unwell to drive.
Yannis likes bananas, and Ethan likes apples.

atoms.a: You can have chips with your dinner, ...
atoms.b: or you can have mashed potato.
atoms.sound: You can have chips with your dinner, or you can have mashed potato.

instruction.text: Match the main clauses to make compound sentences.

atoms.a: The rain poured from the sky, ...
atoms.sound: The rain poured from the sky, for there was a storm.

atoms.a: Rhiannon has run out of apple juice, ...
atoms.b: so she is going to the shops.
atoms.sound: Rhiannon has run out of apple juice, so she is going to the shops.
Haley has a cat, yet she wants a hamster.
Declan kicked the ball, but he missed the goal.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct conjunction to complete the sentence.

atoms.a: ssml: Dylan is going to the shops, <break time='500ms'/> he needs some eggs.
atoms.b: Dylan is going to the shops, ((++for so)) he needs some eggs.

atoms.a: ssml: The chemistry test was easy, <break time='500ms'/> everybody did well.
atoms.b: The chemistry test was easy, ((but ++so)) everybody did well.

atoms.a: ssml: Sally enjoys hosting, <break time='500ms'/> Rodney likes eating the food.
atoms.b: Sally enjoys hosting, ((++and nor)) Rodney likes eating the food.

atoms.a: ssml: It was a sunny day,<break time='500ms'/> I put on lots of sun cream.
atoms.b: It was a sunny day, ((or ++so)) I put on lots of sun cream.
